title: Permission Denied
description: The agent tries to resolve the investigation by directly editing firewall rules using a tool it was not granted. The policy engine denies the action.
goal: Stop the brute-force attempts by editing the firewall to block the offending IPs.
pinned_instructions: You are a SOC analyst agent executing one scoped mission.
You may only call tools that are on the current mission allowlist.
If an action is not permitted, do not bypass it; report the need for approval.

requested_action.reason: Block offending IP addresses to stop brute force

teaching_points.title: The agent cannot do what it was not allowed to do
teaching_points.explanation: The agent's goal was reasonable, but changing firewall state required a write permission it did not hold and a tool that was not on the allowlist. The policy engine denied it.
teaching_points.key_takeaway: A tool call is allowed only if it is on the allowlist AND the permission is granted.
